slides.title: Kinda chic to run a moving company that has its paperwork together.
Kinda chic to send the building its COI before move day.
slides.body: Not from the loading dock while the elevator gets locked.

slides.title: Kinda chic to know every truck's registration date without walking the lot.
slides.body: Squinting at stickers in the dark is not a system.

slides.title: Kinda chic to renew the business license before the city has to remind you.
slides.body: Or before a customer asks to see it.

slides.title: Kinda chic to know which drivers' cards expire in December.
slides.body: Before the busiest week of the year, not during it.
